description: Create app/lib/api/bookings.ts with all booking API types and functions, then update app/checkout/page.tsx to call the real API (createBooking → initializePayment → redirect) with auth gate, and update app/booking/confirmation/page.tsx to be simplified (ref param only, no mock lookups).
steps: 1. Create app/lib/api/bookings.ts. Define types: ApiBookingStatus ('HELD' | 'CONFIRMED' | 'CHECKED_IN' | 'CHECKED_OUT' | 'CANCELLED' | 'PAYMENT_PENDING' | 'NO_SHOW' | 'PENDING'), CreateBookingPayload ({ roomId: string; checkIn: string; checkOut: string; guests: number; specialRequests?: string }), BookingResponse ({ id: string; hotelId: string; roomId: string; checkIn: string; checkOut: string; guests: number; totalAmount: number; status: ApiBookingStatus; specialRequests?: string; createdAt: string; hotel?: { id: string; name: string; city: string; state: string }; room?: { id: string; name: string; pricePerNight: number } }), InitPaymentResponse ({ paymentUrl: string; reference: string; accessCode: string }). Export functions: createBooking(payload: CreateBookingPayload): Promise<BookingResponse> — POST /api/v1/bookings; initializePayment(bookingId: string): Promise<InitPaymentResponse> — POST /api/v1/bookings/{bookingId}/payment/initialize; getMyBookings(): Promise<BookingResponse[]> — GET /api/v1/bookings/my; cancelBooking(bookingId: string): Promise<void> — POST /api/v1/bookings/{bookingId}/cancel. All use apiClient imported from ./client.

2. Rewrite app/checkout/page.tsx as a 'use client' component. Remove ALL imports from app/hotels/mock and app/search/mock. Add imports: useEffect from react; useAuth from app/lib/auth-context; { createBooking, initializePayment, type CreateBookingPayload } from app/lib/api/bookings; { calcNights, calcBookingCost } from app/lib/booking; { ApiError } from app/lib/api/client. Keep existing imports: useState, useSearchParams, useRouter, Link, TravelerNav, Footer plus all SVG icon components.

Add auth gate in CheckoutInner: const { user, isLoading: authLoading } = useAuth(); useEffect(() => { if (!authLoading && !user) router.push('/auth/signin?redirect=/checkout'); }, [authLoading, user, router]). While auth is loading or user is null, render a loading spinner or null.

Pre-fill guest fields from auth context on mount: useEffect(() => { if (user) { setFirstName(user.firstName); setLastName(user.lastName); setEmail(user.email); } }, [user]).

Remove the hotel/room data lookup from HOTEL_DETAILS/SEARCH_MOCK_HOTELS/HOTEL_ROOM_TYPES/DEFAULT_ROOM_TYPES. Instead, add state: const [hotelName, setHotelName] = useState(''); const [roomName, setRoomName] = useState(''); const [pricePerNight, setPricePerNight] = useState(0); const [dataLoading, setDataLoading] = useState(true); const [dataError, setDataError] = useState(''). Fetch hotel/room info in a useEffect: fetch /api/v1/hotels/{hotelId}/rooms via a plain fetch (no auth needed, public endpoint) to get room name and pricePerNight, and /api/v1/hotels/{hotelId} for hotel name and city. Use the RoomAvailability type from app/lib/api/search.ts and HotelDetail. On error set dataError state and show error state. Store hotelName, roomName (matched by roomId), and pricePerNight.

Add submit state: const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false); const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState('').

Replace handlePay with an async function: async function handlePay(): validate fields (same as before). Then: setSubmitting(true); setSubmitError(''); try { const payload: CreateBookingPayload = { roomId, checkIn: checkInInput, checkOut: checkOutInput, guests: Number(guests), specialRequests: specialRequests.trim() || undefined }; const booking = await createBooking(payload); const payment = await initializePayment(booking.id); window.location.href = payment.paymentUrl; } catch (err) { const msg = err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'; setSubmitError(msg); } finally { setSubmitting(false); }.

Update the pay button: disabled={submitting}, show 'Processing…' text when submitting. Show submitError in the error alert div above the button.

Remove the payment card/bank form sections entirely — Paystack handles payment collection at their hosted page. Replace the Section 3 'Secure payment' section with a simple notice card: 'You will be redirected to Paystack's secure payment page to complete your booking.' with a lock icon.

Keep all other UI unchanged: date section, your details section, special requests section, right-column booking summary (use pricePerNight state for calculations).

Keep the existing `export default function CheckoutPage()` wrapping `<Suspense><CheckoutInner /></Suspense>` pattern.

3. Rewrite app/booking/confirmation/page.tsx as a simplified server component. Remove ALL imports from app/hotels/mock and app/search/mock. The page only needs the ref param from URL — it no longer looks up hotel/room data from mock. Change the component to read: ref, hotelName, roomName, checkIn, checkOut, guests, total from searchParams (the checkout page will pass all these as URL params). The searchParams Promise shape: { ref?: string; hotelName?: string; roomName?: string; checkIn?: string; checkOut?: string; guests?: string; total?: string }. Remove all mock data lookups. Remove the room-not-found guard. Keep the full page UI (success banner, booking reference card, booking details card, action buttons, support link) but populate from URL params directly. The total is read from the `total` param (passed as the totalAmount from the BookingResponse). The booking details card rows: Hotel, Room, Check-in, Check-out, Guests, Total paid — all from params. Keep the export const instant = false; Keep calcNights removed (not needed anymore — only display). Keep calcBookingCost removed (total comes from API/URL param). Add import for formatDate helper (keep local). Remove all unused imports after cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: app/lib/api/bookings.ts exists with no 'any' types, exports createBooking, initializePayment, getMyBookings, cancelBooking, and all four types
app/checkout/page.tsx imports nothing from app/hotels/mock or app/search/mock
app/checkout/page.tsx pre-fills firstName/lastName/email from useAuth user object on mount
app/checkout/page.tsx auth gate redirects unauthenticated users to /auth/signin?redirect=/checkout
app/checkout/page.tsx submit flow calls createBooking then initializePayment then window.location.href = payment.paymentUrl
app/booking/confirmation/page.tsx imports nothing from app/hotels/mock or app/search/mock
app/booking/confirmation/page.tsx reads all display data from URL params (no API calls)
npx next build exits with code 0, zero TypeScript errors

findings: Build passes (exit 0, zero TS errors). The confirmation page 'Contact hotel' button now links to /hotels (generic) instead of /hotels/{hotelId} because hotelId is no longer passed as a URL param — only hotelName/roomName/total/ref/checkIn/checkOut/guests are passed. The original page used hotelId from URL to build the link; the new simplified design drops hotelId so a generic link is used instead. All three steps implemented and verified.
